correctness.rationale: The chemical incidence Laplacian has identical row action inside every center/leaf block. Its coupling term therefore cancels identically in intra-block differences; applying the 1-Lipschitz triangular fold and the tent Lipschitz constant yields the exact all-trajectory induction. Uncoupled lower-branch trajectories attain equality. At the threshold all coordinates in the balanced kernel polytope are fixed; leaf constraints are independent and a strictly interior balanced point proves its full affine dimension. The local fixed equation reduces exactly to nonzero-coupling times the Laplacian in an identity-fold neighborhood. Above the threshold two distinct uncoupled scalar fixed points provide counterexamples. The 15159 exact-rational checks independently verify the signed incidence normalization and examples but do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: The primary 2021 paper expressly leaves sufficiency at the tent stability threshold supported numerically. This result closes its natural mathematical question for all initial conditions, every hyperflower size and arbitrarily strong real coupling, supplying an optimal quantitative convergence rate. The sharp critical polytope identifies a geometric obstruction of dimension d-ell and distinguishes attraction below the boundary from persistent nonsynchronized states exactly at the boundary. These facts are motivated by the published hyperflower synchronization transition, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
